title: Bring the Rift system online
successMessage: The bridge viewport blooms with a stable Rift corridor.

steps.instruction: Type tmux and press Enter to open the surface Rift.
steps.helix: The ship has one way down. Start tmux and the surface session will answer.

title: Open a named armory Rift
successMessage: The armory destination stabilizes as a named session.

steps.instruction: Type tmux new -s armory to open the armory destination.
steps.helix: Names turn panic into navigation. The armory must be called deliberately.

title: Leave the armory without collapsing it
successMessage: The armory remains alive while the captain steps back to the bridge.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then d to detach from the armory session.
steps.helix: Detach is controlled absence. Leave the room, not the work.

title: Read the manifest and return to session 0
successMessage: The surface Rift answers with the bracket cannon now in hand.

steps.instruction: Type tmux ls to inspect the active sessions on the Rift Manifest.
steps.helix: List first. Jump second. Orientation always comes before motion.

steps.instruction: Type tmux attach -t 0 to return to the surface Rift.
steps.helix: Session 0 is still the surface. Reattach with intent.
